steps.en:
1) Half-yearly rate $r = \frac{10\%}{2} = 5\% = \frac{1}{20}$; cycles $n = 2 \times 1 = 2$.
2) Amount $= 8680 \times (1.05)^2 \approx 9569.7$.
3) Compound Interest $= A - P $= 889.7$ $\approx$ **₹ 890**.
2 cycles at 5% give effective CI rate $= 5+5+\frac{5^2}{100} = 10.25\%$ of 8,680 $= \mathbf{Rs. 890}$!

solution.en:
Method 1: Half-Yearly Rule (r = 5%, n = 2): 1) Half-yearly rate $r = \frac{10\%}{2} = 5\% = \frac{1}{20}$; cycles $n = 2 \times 1 = 2$.
2) Amount $= 8680 \times (1.05)^2 \approx 9569.7$.
3) Compound Interest $= A - P $= 889.7$ $\approx$ **₹ 890**.

Method 2: 2-Cycle Successive % Formula (2r + r²/100): 2 cycles at 5% give effective CI rate $= 5+5+\frac{5^2}{100} = 10.25\%$ of 8,680 $= \mathbf{Rs. 890}$!
